name: Dinosaurs
scope: Yes if it is a dinosaur, dated to when it lived, or a turning point in the dinosaurs' own story
boundary: Dinosaurs owns the animals themselves and the bookends of their reign; their discovery goes to Bone Hunters, and the life around them (mammals, pterosaurs, sea reptiles, flowering plants) stays in Before Us.
example_beats: Eoraptor, one of the first dinosaurs (231 million years ago)
Coelophysis hunts in packs (215 million years ago)
Plateosaurus, an early long-neck (214 million years ago)
Archaeopteryx, the first bird (150 million years ago)
The asteroid ends their reign (66 million years ago)
notes: One beat per dinosaur, dated to the start of its fossil range (the range in `note`), plus the first dinosaurs and the asteroid. Spread the beats across the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous by their length. Never name a period or 'million years' on a card.
